{{Quote|A blow from a Bakuuni master can pulverize stone.|Crix Sunburris|<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
The '''Bakuuni Hand''' was a type of martial art practiced by some members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Bakuuni martial artists strengthened their hands, feet, and forearms with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] while making unarmed strikes; according to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Crix Sunburris]], who included a mention of the Bakuuni Hand while covering exotic weapons specialists in ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', a trained Bakuuni master could pulverize solid rock with a single strike.
